title: Elizabeth Zelilidis Alias Elizabeth Chuhin

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch.
REPORT
（印：SECRET）
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. E. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 8737
Date September 16, 1938

Subject Elisabeth Zelilidis alias Elisabeth Chuhin, subject to Bubbling Well
F.I.R. 1906/38

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Crawford. S.D.

Enquiries show that the female named Elisabeth Zeli-
lidis alias Elisabeth Chuhin is known to have been the propriet-
ress of various houses of ill fame in Shanghai. In this connection
she came to the notice of the French Police in June, 1932 when it
was discovered that a boarding house she and her paramour J. Schwartz
conducted at 700 Rue Bourgeat was a secret brothel. In February,
1934 she made an unsuccessful application for a licence to con-
duct a brothel at 586 Avenue du Roi Albert. Nevertheless, it was
ascertained by the police later during the same year that she
carried on her business at the above address, and on 12-2-35 she
was brought before the 2nd S.S.D. Court and fined $50 for infrin-
gement of Art. 44, parag. 3 of the C.C.C. ( C.R.C. 2350 ).

In October 1934 she was reported to have been in bu-
siness relations with Boris Belousoff, notorious owner of a chain
of tolerated houses in the Far East ( File E- 695 ).

In 1935 she and her paramour resided at House 1, Lane
130 Kungping Road. During that period they are reported to have
made several trips to Canton. Until recently they are believed to
to have had an interest in one of the houses of ill fame situated
on Soochow Road.

Enquiries at the local Greek Consulate-General show
that no information is available there regarding Mrs Zelilidis
as she was not recognized as a Greek citizen.

She is not registered with the Russian Emigrants' Com-
mittee, 118/1 Moulmein Road, or at the Council of United Russian
Organization (SORO), 8 Avenue Dubail. However, the register of the
former organizations contains an entry to the effect that one
Miss. Chuhin registered with the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau
several years ago, giving the following particulars about herself:-

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
第一科，特别股。
报告
（印：机密）
上海公共租界工部局警务处
东南区登记处
编号 S. B. D. 8737
日期 1938年9月16日

事由 伊丽莎白·泽利利迪斯（Elisabeth Zelilidis），又名伊丽莎白·楚欣（Elisabeth Chuhin），静安寺捕房备案。
档案号 1906/38

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）撰写。由克劳福德（C. Crawford）转发。特别股。

经查，名为伊丽莎白·泽利利迪斯、又名伊丽莎白·楚欣的女子，已知曾在上海经营多处妓院。在此方面，她于1932年6月引起法国警察局的注意，当时发现她与情夫J.施瓦茨（J. Schwartz）在布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）700号经营的寄宿公寓实为秘密妓院。1934年2月，她申请在阿尔贝国王大道（Avenue du Roi Albert）586号经营妓院的执照未获批准。尽管如此，警方在同一年晚些时候查明，她在上述地址继续从事该业务，并于1935年2月12日被提审至第二特区地方法院，因违反《中华民国刑法》第44条第3款而被罚款50元（刑事案件卷宗号 2350）。

1934年10月，据报她与鲍里斯·别洛乌索夫（Boris Belousoff）有业务往来，后者是远东地区一家连锁受容忍妓院的臭名昭著的业主（档案 E-695）。

1935年，她与情夫居住在公平路130弄1号。在此期间，据报他们曾多次前往广州。直到最近，据信他们在苏州河路的一处妓院中拥有权益。

向当地希腊总领事馆查询显示，由于泽利利迪斯夫人未被承认为希腊公民，该馆没有关于她的任何资料。

她未在莫尔梅因路（Moulmein Road）118/1号的俄国侨民委员会注册，也未在杜巴伊路（Avenue Dubail）8号的俄罗斯联合组织理事会（SORO）注册。然而，前者的登记册中有一条记录，大意是一名楚欣小姐（Miss. Chuhin）于数年前在上海公安局注册，提供了以下关于她本人的详细信息：-

    " Miss Elisabeth Grigorievna CHUHINA, born on October 22,
1904 at Archangel. Arrived in Shanghai from Harbin on August 12,
1929. Resides at 399 Avenue Joffre".

    In all probability, this woman is identical with Mrs.
Zelilidis. It is of interest to note that when arrested by the
French Police she stated that she was born in 1899 at Trebisond,
Turkey.

                                    G. Prokofieff
                                    D. S. I.

    “伊丽莎白·格里戈里耶芙娜·楚希娜（Elisabeth Grigorievna CHUHINA）小姐，1904年10月22日出生于阿尔汉格尔斯克。1929年8月12日从哈尔滨抵达上海。居住于霞飞路399号”。

    该女子极有可能与泽利利迪斯夫人为同一人。值得注意的是，她被法国警察局逮捕时声称自己于1899年出生在土耳其的特拉布宗（Trebisond）。

                                    G. 普罗科菲耶夫
                                    特别调查员
